items.title: Meta Platforms (META) Commits $300 Million To Biohub And Backs Indiana Solar
items.summary: Meta Platforms (NasdaqGS:META) has committed $300 million to the $1.8b Biohub AI Biology Initiative focused on drug development. The Biohub Virtual Biology Initiative brings Meta together with the U.S. government and major technology groups to apply predictive AI models and data sharing to pharmaceutical research. Meta has also signed a long term solar Power Purchase Agreement tied to the Reclamation Solar project in Indiana to support its energy needs. The Biohub AI Biology Initiative...
